notes:
0.93.7: a fixed InstaPay / wallet payment updates (or cancels) the screenshot still asked for; several days off picked on a calendar; a month's withdrawals for one employee typed under each day and saved together; «مرتبي» without a line per withdrawal.
0.93.6: the withdrawal alerts are checked with the day's last close only, not all day.
0.93.5: «📦 Goods» on a past day picks the item from the bar's list; the month page shows the net up to the last closed day (revenue − expenses − salaries so far); a new Telegram section «💵 Withdrawal alerts»: someone took more than he earned so far, or has less than a day left.
0.93.4: fixes the month page's «whole day» window (adding expense / withdrawal rows, removing them, the live drawer line, the goods note); a booking of the same day pops up every hour from the shift's opening.
0.93.3: a shorter salaries report on Telegram (withdrawals, days off with who covered, deductions and additions with their dates, what's left); moving stock from the storeroom in packs and loose pieces.
0.93.2: the InstaPay / wallet / cash-out / electricity screenshot is asked of the cashier holding the shift, whoever pressed (with who did it), the owner's own Telegram when nobody is linked, and the ones asked of nobody in the last two days are sent when the program starts.
0.93.1: the month page - the day's window stays open after adding or fixing anything (a withdrawal, an expense, a leave, a deduction, attendance, the whole day), refreshed in place, so the day can be finished in one go.
0.93.0: the month page - «📦 Goods» on a past day is recorded as money only (not added to the stock), with a note listing the month's goods already added from the drawer so they aren't written twice; no reason needed in the month's expenses window.
0.92.3: the month page - a past day's revenue, expenses and withdrawals in one window with one save, the drawer difference shown as you type; no reason needed for the month's expenses.
0.92.2: «📅 الشهر» — «➕ إيراد اليوم» on a past day (PS5 / PS4 / bar / cards; the second shop: revenue + services; InstaPay, wallet) with what was really in the drawer → over / short, shown in the month, the daily and the monthly reports; ✏️ / 🗑 on it.
0.92.1: «📅 الشهر» (both shops), the month's totals (time PS5/PS4, bar, cards, expenses without salaries, salaries due/taken/left) also in the monthly report, «تحت الحساب» on the time, and the ✕ of the WiFi-cards move window — they missed the 0.92.0 build.
0.92.0: «👤 فلان جه؟» — the cashier on duty is asked about each colleague 5 minutes after his time (again every 5): «came» records his attendance, «not here» (reason + when) goes to the owner who approves or deducts, the automatic deduction waits; attendance by hand (time + hours) in the employee sheet and the day review; «مرتبي» up to the last check-in is now a setting (off by default); a «📅 الشهر» page (the main shop / the second shop): every day of the month with its revenue, expenses, withdrawals, leaves, deductions and attendance, adding and editing for this month and the previous one, and the month's totals (time by PS5 / PS4, bar, cards, expenses without salaries, salaries due / taken / left) — also in the monthly report; «تحت الحساب» is paid on the time (the drinks stay at full price till the close); the ✕ of the WiFi-cards move window closes it.
0.91.0: an employee's «مرتبي» shows what he earned up to the last day he checked in; the month's expenses (this month or the previous one, both shops) with edit, delete and «add an expense on a past day»; deductions and additions on a past day; a fixed weekly day off per employee (picked from the bot, approved by the manager, deducted every week, swapped only with the colleague who has that day); the owner can give a manager the whole payroll (except his own pay).
0.90.1: the shift's debts card shows what is still unpaid; an account moved with its customer to another device is no longer shown as a debt.
0.90.0: fixes - the WiFi-cards link (both apps used the same port), one InstaPay screenshot per bill, a permission's start time, the day's InstaPay list in the daily report, the day's last close waits until every device and table is closed, and a closed table can't be paid twice.
0.89.2: WiFi - put an already printed card on a device or table by its code (checked with Wi-Code first).
0.89.1: Telegram - commands and buttons used inside a group topic now answer in the same topic instead of the private chat.
0.89.0: the owner / manager can fix or delete any sale of the month - a device's time, drinks, payment, device (repriced), discount and shift; a table; an expense; a debt and its collection; a booking's deposit; a cash-out - with a reason; the drawer, the shift, the reports and the stock follow; deleted ones are kept in a delete log and can be brought back. Also 0.87: WiFi cards and 0.85/0.86: the program is now called 1-Zone.
